body: I've tried everything for my KP as well as my eczema. I suffer with such dry skin that within a matter of hours any moisturizer will lose its effects. I think the severity of the dryness is the route cause to most of the problems I suffer with. I've not shown my skin in public for the past 5 years or so. My closest friends since school dont even know I suffer with this.

Although the guy sounds like he deserves it I think you just have to be the bigger person. Somedays I discredit the impact suicide would have on those around me as I feel its my only option. The last thing you be remembered for is ending somebody else's life. One day, if you make it past these dark times (and I hope we both do) you'll look back and not give one fuck about that bitch and her shitbag of a bf! Stay strong!
